mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by >1pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate over the past 3 months, indicating a rapidly tightening labor market, will lead to wage inflation and reduced corporate profitability, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE declines >0.5pp in 3 months but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production growth slows by more than 2% year-over-year, it signals a supply-driven slowdown that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by rising unemployment.
failure_condition: INDPRO y-o-y growth < -2% and UNRATE rising, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >50% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 3%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, as higher borrowing costs reduce investment and consumption.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 3% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales, indicating a weakening consumer sector, will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, especially if accompanied by a rise in unemployment.
failure_condition: RSAFS declines >5% y-o-y and UNRATE rising, but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >50% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: Steadily rising payroll employment, indicating a strong labor market, will support consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS rising y-o-y but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in >40% of instances.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the consumer price index, indicating high inflation, will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the Fed is forced to raise interest rates aggressively.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL rises >0.5% m-o-m but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp slowdown in housing starts, indicating a weakening construction sector, will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days, especially if accompanied by falling industrial production.
failure_condition: HOUST declines >10% y-o-y and INDPRO falling, but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in >50% of triggered instances.
